correctness.rationale: The strictly stable Lévy density gives first-exit small-time marked hazard kappa_i±; exact self-similarity yields E_i[exp(-u tau_L) 1_{exit±}]=kappa_i±/(u L^alpha)+o(L^-alpha) with fixed u>0. Conditioning on reset versus exit yields F±=a±+diag(b)KF±. For s=theta L^-alpha, a_i±=L^-alpha*kappa_i±/r+o, b_i=1-L^-alpha*(theta+kappa_i)/r+o; any subsequence converges to a constant right eigenvector of irreducible K (periodic allowed), and left multiplication by stationary pi gives (theta+kbar)F±=kbar±. Uniform small exponential moments from the negative s expansion prove all polynomial moment convergence. Independently checked finite killed generator for nonreversible reset chain; it is not a simulation of infinite-activity stable paths.
